title: Pistachio Papi Smooth Spread 200g $7.20 (was $12.00, 40% off) @ Coles
body:
Deal: Pistachio Papi Smooth Spread 200g $7.20 (was $12.00, 40% off) @ Coles

[OZKap] Vegetable Oil (Sustainably Sourced Palm ), Sugar, Milk Powder, Pistachios (16%) , Lactose (Milk), Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin),Natural Flavour, Salt, Colour (141).
[Bacha] with just 16% Pistachios they named it Pistachio spread. 😐
[Disabled-User] Wait till you find out what percentage of almonds make up almond milk.
[OZKap] The major constituents of cows' milk are water (87.4%) and milk solids (12.6%)
[smartazz104] Wait until you find out that you can't even milk almonds.
[peterc] Oil and sugar spread with 16% pistachio flavour….
[liongalahad] That's how it works with most spreads? 16% pistachio is actually decent for a commercial product. As a comparison, Nutella only has 13% hazelnut
[iMagoo] Leaps and bounds. Papi is a crap product with great marketing - the key to success in this day and age.
[OZKap] Now that's more like it
Ingredients
Pistachio 45%, Sugar, Milk powder, Extra virgin olive oil, Non hydrogenated vegetable fats (sunflower, cocoa butter), Emulsifier: soy lecithin.
[YodaBaby] It is sickly sweet and I personally find once pistachios get grounded into a paste, the intense flavour taste a bit chemical.
[fantombloo] Not sure what you mean by chemical flavour. I've barely tried commercial versions but I make my own in a wet grinder - just pistachios, sugar, and some macadamia butter to give it a bit smoother texture - and it tastes awesome. Half a kilo usually disappears in a week, just by my index finger.
